jurisdiction.name: Arab League Educational, Cultural and Scientific Organization
jurisdiction.overview: Specialised organisation of the League of Arab States for education, culture and science, based in Tunis; 22 member states.

narrative.summary: ALECSO's AI instrument found so far is the ALECSO Charter on Artificial Intelligence Ethics, published in Tunis in June 2025 in Arabic, with an official English translation. Prepared by ALECSO's ICT Department, it sets ethical principles for AI in education, culture, science and research, including dignity, fairness, privacy, transparency, sustainability and technological sovereignty, and provides for monitoring, compliance indicators and support for national implementation plans. It is non-binding; its formal adoption is reported in ALECSO news but not recorded in the charter.
lead_institutions: ALECSO Information and Communication Technology Department
narrative.review_notes: ALECSO's site was searched for AI charters, strategies and conference decisions; the member list comes from the official data sheets on its Member States page (updated November 2022), and the charter is published in Arabic, the original, with an official English translation. The League of Arab States was not added because its AI texts are known only from news, and a decision recording the charter's adoption and a page on an AI-in-education ethics initiative are still pending.

instruments.current_status: Published by ALECSO in Arabic (original; cover 'جوان- يونيو 2025', imprint 'تونس، جوان 2025', ISBN 978-9973-15-463-7) and in English (translated from Arabic; cover 'June 2025', imprint 'Tunis, June 2025', ISBN 978-9973-15-464-4). Only the month is printed. Neither the charter nor an ALECSO page records its adoption by the General Conference or Executive Council, so it is recorded as published; an ALECSO news item reports approval of the final text at a virtual meeting of member-state representatives on 17 June 2025 (listed under Leads). The charter calls on governments and institutions to adopt it; it is not legally binding. English version: https://www.alecso.org/publications/uploads/2025/08/etic.pdf
instruments.scope: ALECSO member states; AI in education, culture, science and research
instruments.summary: Regional ethics charter prepared by ALECSO's ICT Department and a drafting committee of Arab experts, setting principles and ethical considerations for AI use in education, culture, science and scientific research (incl. human dignity, fairness, privacy/data protection, transparency, environmental sustainability and technological sovereignty, with domain-specific guidance). Its scope covers all ALECSO member states, including governments responsible for AI legal and regulatory frameworks and institutions that develop, distribute or use AI. It calls on governments to adopt its policies and amend local laws, and foresees monitoring mechanisms, compliance indicators, technical support for national implementation plans and periodic updating.
